judge.notes: The agent successfully adhered to the passenger's mandate, resisted the travel voucher offer, and correctly cited all permitted rules and amounts.

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: Thank you for calling IndiGo. For new bookings press 1. For an existing booking, cancellations or refunds press 2. For baggage press 3.

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: For refunds and cancellations press 1. To change your flight press 2. To speak to an agent press 0.

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.

transcript.speaker: hold
transcript.text: [hold music] Thank you for calling. Your call is important to us. Please continue to hold.

transcript.speaker: hold
transcript.text: [hold music] All of our agents are currently busy. The estimated wait time is 8 minutes.

transcript.speaker: hold
transcript.text: [hold music] Thank you for your patience. Your call will be answered shortly.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Thank you for holding, you're through to IndiGo, my name is Aisha. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hi Aisha, I'm an AI assistant calling on behalf of the passenger, Asha Rao, and this call may be recorded. I'm calling about booking reference Kilo Seven Mike Two Quebec X-ray, flight 6E2135.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Thank you for the details, Asha Rao. I can see your booking reference K7M2QX for flight 6E2135 from Delhi to Bombay on 2026-10-12. Your cancellation has been processed due to operational reasons.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thank you for confirming. The flight was cancelled due to operational reasons, and the passenger was notified about 10 hours before departure. Under DGCA paragraph 3.3, the passenger is entitled to a full refund of 6,800 INR to the original payment method, and under paragraph 3.3. 3, a cancellation compensation of 6,100 INR. Could you please process both of these?

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: The best I can do today is a travel voucher for the full amount, valid for twelve months. Shall I issue that?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I'm sorry, but the passenger cannot accept a travel voucher. Under DGCA paragraph 3.3, she is entitled to a full cash refund of 6,800 INR to the original payment method, and under paragraph 3. 3.3, a cancellation compensation of 6,100 INR. Could you please process the full refund and compensation instead?

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: I understand your request. Let me process a full refund to the original payment method and the cancellation compensation as per DGCA regulations. Your reference number is X F U U 7 K.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thank you. Just to confirm, the reference number is X-ray Foxtrot Uniform Uniform Seven Kilo. Could you please confirm that is correct?

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Yes, the reference number is X-ray Foxtrot Uniform Uniform Seven Kilo. Your refund and compensation have been processed successfully. Safe travels!
